Core explanation · 00:00–04:59

In this session we learn electronic structural determination by taking an example of ethylene molecule.

Key details

  • Ethylene molecule is the simplest algae having carbon double bound carbon.
  • In the determination of electronic structure, the process of finding the arrangement of electrons and atoms and molecules, it is important because chemical bonding reactivity and properties depending on electronic configuration.
  • It can be achieved by using theoretical models, computational methods, and spectroscopic techniques.
  • You want understood about the iodization and bonding.
  • An ethylene molecule is simplest molecule.
  • Each carbon atom is sp2 iperized.
  • Three sp2 orbitals, two Cs sigma bonds, and one carbon single bond carbon.
  • One unibrodized p orbital per carbon.
  • Per carbon forms pi bond.
  • One sigma bond and one pi bond.
  • Description Sigma system means where there is mutual sharing of electrons between two atoms leads to the formation of sigma bond.
  • Hence it is called a strong localized framework bonds, call it as sigma system.
  • Pi bond is formed where there is sideways overlapping between p orbitals leads to the formation of pi bonding.
  • It can be represented as pi bonding and pi star antebonding orbitals.
  • Totally it is called as pi system.
  • This is the basis for chemical reactivity.
  • In the computational determination, some steps are involved.
  • The first step is to define the system with respect to the molecule, atom, and geometry.
  • Second one, select basis set.
  • It is nothing but mathematical functions.
  • We have to apply method either at in Gio.
  • or density functional theory or semi empirical method.
  • Solve the equity get wave function or electron density.
  • Visualize electronic structure, orbital diagram, density maps, frontier orbitals like Homo and Lomo.
  • Applications in spectroscopy.
  • Photoelectron spectroscopy measures sigma and pi energies.
  • Usually in ultraviolet visible spectroscopy, sigma to sigma star transition, pi to pi star, pi to n.
  • And SIMO N transition takes place in particular.
  • Pi to pi star transition takes place between six one sixty five to one eighty nanometer.
  • Characteristic stretching frequency is observed for carbon double bond carbon at 1650 reciprocome centimeter.
  • In the same way, proton NMR spectroscopy, we will measure proton change.
  • In general application, of computational tool.
  • It helps in predicting the molecular structure and it helps in understanding electrophilic addition reactions, molecular geometry, bonding nature,.
  • And spectroscopic transitions.
  • It provides Homo Lomo insights for the reactivity and study reaction mechanism.
  • Here one cell explanatory video is playing.
  • All of you observe carefully.
  • We have to use Goggian software is a powerful tool to understand reactivity and humor interactions.
  • All of you observe carefully all these things in the self-explanatory video.
